# Command reference

Every operation in this area, as a `metorial-admin` CLI command and as a tool on the Metorial admin MCP server (`mcp.metorial.com/mcp`). API version: `mt_2026_01_01_magnetar`. 65 CLI commands, 62 MCP tools.

- **CLI**: prefix with `metorial-admin`. Run `metorial-admin <command> --help` for every flag. Write commands also accept `--body` or `--body-file` with a JSON object.
- **MCP tool**: pass inputs in snake_case (`<provider-id>` → `provider_id`). Instance-scoped tools also accept an optional `instance_id`.
- **Effect**: `read` changes nothing; `write` creates or changes something; `destructive` deletes, revokes, archives, or runs code. Confirm destructive actions with the user first.
- **—** in a column means that interface has no equivalent. Use the alternative named in the summary, or call the API path with `metorial-admin fetch` / the `call_endpoint` tool.

## skills

| CLI command | MCP tool | Effect | Summary | Required inputs | API |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `skills create` | `skills_create` | write | Create skill | --name | `POST /skills` |
| `skills delete <skill-id>` | `skills_delete` | destructive | Delete skill | <skill-id> | `DELETE /skills/:skillId` |
| `skills get <skill-id>` | `skills_get` | read | Get skill | <skill-id> | `GET /skills/:skillId` |
| `skills list` | `skills_list` | read | List skills |  | `GET /skills` |
| `skills update <skill-id>` | `skills_update` | write | Update skill | <skill-id> | `PATCH /skills/:skillId` |
